Lee Sin occupies the upper portion beside the left lane wall. Lux is farther down the same side. Ryze and Ahri are close together below Lux, with Ahri to Ryze's right.

A large red circular ground effect surrounds much of the lower cluster and extends toward Lux. Lee Sin's visible model is above that circle. Bright blue, white, red, and yellow effects overlap the champions.
Thin red diagonal lines extend across the upper part of the lane toward Lee Sin's vicinity; their cause and resolved effect cannot be identified from this frame alone.

Minions are visible above the upper champion and along the lower edge of the scene, with at least one blue-bar minion near the central fight. The frame does not establish full wave sizes, movement direction, or which wave is advancing.
